name: Alexis Weik

sponsored.t: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; makes technical amendments to the chapter incorporating such association.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Church of Pentecost, USA, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Church of Pentecost, USA, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for parcels located in the county of Suffolk.

sponsored.t: Relates to the approval of applications of charter schools and establishing the board of regents as the primary charter vetting and oversight authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to the approval of applications of charter schools and establishing the board of regents as the primary charter vetting and oversight authority; provides that charter school applicants shall first apply to the community district education council or the board of education of the school district for approval for renewal of a charter within a certain amount of time and public hearings shall be conducted on such proposed application; provides that school district funding shall be contingent on application certification by the community district education council or the voters of the school district.

sponsored.t: Designates March twenty-first as Down Syndrome Awareness Day
sponsored.sum: Designates March twenty-first as a day of commemoration to be known as "Down Syndrome Awareness Day".

sponsored.t: Relates to the electric school bus mandate; prohibits a mandate requiring school districts to purchase, operate or maintain any certain type of school buses; repeals certain provisions relating to electric buses
sponsored.sum: Removes references to the electric school bus mandate; provides that there shall be no mandate requiring school districts to purchase, operate or maintain any certain type of school buses and that the superintendent of each school district shall have the sole authority to determine the types of school buses such school district will purchase, operate and maintain; repeals certain provisions of law relating to electric school buses.
sponsored.fis: Eliminates costs associated with mandatory conversion to electric buses and related infrastructure

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the use of certain moneys received by the Bohemia Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
sponsored.sum: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to the use of certain moneys received by the Bohemia Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association to taxes due on premiums received before January 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Michael J. Cappiello to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Michael J. Cappiello to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department prior to its merger with the MTA and the state retirement system.

sponsored.t: Establishes term limits for the office of governor and for members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Establishes term limits for the office of governor and for members of the legislature; changes the term for members of the legislature to a four year term.

sponsored.t: Requires cardiac fitness certificates for interscholastic athletes in all public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires cardiac fitness certificates including an electrocardiogram or echocardiogram for interscholastic athletes in all public schools.

sponsored.t: Establishes a commission to reform tier V and tier VI membership status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Establishes a commission to reform tier V and tier VI membership status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Provides distinctive license plates for family members of police officers killed in the line of duty and eliminates the registration fee for family member distinctive license plates
sponsored.sum: Provides distinctive license plates for the parents, spouses, children, step-children, siblings, step-siblings, and grandparents of police officers killed in the line of duty; eliminates the registration fee for family member distinctive license plates.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain caffeine safety warnings and labeling requirements
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain caffeine safety warnings for covered establishments for items with high caffeine; establishes caffeine labeling requirements for food and dietary supplements containing certain amounts of caffeine per serving.

sponsored.t: Requires that all new motor vehicles sold or leased at new motor vehicle dealerships include a spare tire
sponsored.sum: Requires that all new motor vehicles sold or leased at new motor vehicle dealerships include a spare tire, whether or not equipped with standard radial or run-flat tires.

sponsored.t: Prohibits employers from engaging in discrimination on the basis of a protected class when using artificial intelligence in certain employment practices
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from engaging in discrimination on the basis of a protected class when using artificial intelligence for recruitment, hiring, promotion, renewal of employment, selection for training or apprenticeship, discharge, discipline, tenure, or the terms, privileges, or conditions of employment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the manufacture for sale, sale, hold or offer for sale, or distribution of lab grown meat or 3D printed meat in the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture for sale, sale, hold or offer for sale, or distribution of lab grown meat or 3D printed meat in the state; creates penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Ensures repeat offenders qualify for bail and pre-trial detention when the principal has been convicted of one or more misdemeanor or felony offenses
sponsored.sum: Ensures repeat offenders qualify for bail and pre-trial detention when the principal has been convicted of one or more misdemeanor or felony offenses within the immediate preceding five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the Gold Award and Eagle Scout achievement scholarship
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the Gold Award and Eagle Scout achievement scholarship; authorizes a scholarship of $500 per year for high school graduates attending a New York state public post-secondary institution who have achieved a Gold Award from the Girl Scouts of the United States of America or an Eagle Scout from the Boy Scouts of America.

sponsored.t: Creates the rescued animals spay and neuter fund
sponsored.sum: Creates the rescued animals spay and neuter fund; authorizes the department of taxation and finance to place a check-off box on income tax returns for taxpayers to contribute money to the fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York nurse expansion program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York nurse expansion program which provides awards to undergraduate students who are matriculated in an approved undergraduate program leading to a career in nursing at a New York state public or private degree granting institution of higher education.

sponsored.t: Requires a person in a parental relation to a child be physically present during any immunization
sponsored.sum: Requires a parent, guardian or person in a parental relation to a child under the age of eighteen to be physically present when any immunization is administered to such child.

sponsored.t: Repeals the clean slate act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the clean slate act in its entirety to prior existing law.

sponsored.t: Relates to vehicular assault and vehicular manslaughter
sponsored.sum: Relates to vehicular assault and vehicular manslaughter when a person operates a motor vehicle without having been licensed to operate a motor vehicle in the state of New York, and while operating said motor vehicle causes the death of another person.

sponsored.t: Establishes a home heating oil rebate program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a home heating oil rebate program for residential home heating oil customers to receive a rebate of one dollar per gallon of grade number two heating oil purchased from July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026, of a limit up to five hundred gallons.

sponsored.t: Relates to a real property tax relief credit and an enhanced real property tax circuit breaker credit
sponsored.sum: Provides a real property tax relief credit and an enhanced real property tax circuit breaker credit for certain taxpayers who meet income requirements and other eligibility.
sponsored.fis: To be determined; however, there would be no new State spending.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York state health care quality and cost containment commission to issue a report on coverage for chronic Lyme disease
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York state health care quality and cost containment commission to issue a report considering the impact on health insurance costs and quality of legislation requiring coverage of long term and chronic Lyme disease and other tick-borne diseases.

sponsored.t: Relates to the homeowner tax rebate credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to the homeowner tax rebate credit by extending the provisions to apply for tax year two thousand twenty-five and every tax year thereafter.

sponsored.t: Imposes term limits for members of the assembly and senate of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides that members of the assembly and senate of New York shall not serve more than six two-year terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to the liability of the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways
sponsored.sum: Imposes liability on the state for damages to persons caused by defects in state highways year round.

sponsored.t: Provides real property tax relief to certain veterans
sponsored.sum: Provides real property tax relief to veterans who have at least ten years of service in the U.S. armed forces or in the organized militia of the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act" which provides for a withholding of a certain amount of state funding for a defunding municipality.

sponsored.t: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for certain well water testing
sponsored.sum: Provides for a personal income tax deduction, once every three years up to six hundred dollars, for the testing of potable well water by a certified laboratory.

sponsored.t: Requires nursing homes and assisted living facilities to provide and maintain automated external defibrillators
sponsored.sum: Requires nursing homes and assisted living facilities to provide and maintain automated external defibrillators in quantities and types deemed by the commissioner to be adequate to ensure ready and appropriate access for use during emergencies.

sponsored.t: Relates to publishing data on the effects of bail reform
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of court administration and division of criminal justice services to collect and publish certain data relating to bail reform.

sponsored.t: Relates to renaming the bridges of the state highway system after New York state's medal of honor recipients
sponsored.sum: Relates to renaming the bridges of the state highway system after New York state's medal of honor recipients.
sponsored.fis: Minimal. Bridge signs containing the name of Medal of Honor recipients will be installed taking into consideration existing signs that are in need of replacement.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals and healthcare facilities providing emergency services to develop plans to provide reasonable accommodations for service animals
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals and healthcare facilities which provide emergency services to develop plans to provide reasonable accommodations to house a patient's service animal until such time as they can be picked up.

sponsored.t: Protects women's sports from unfair competition
sponsored.sum: Protects women's sports in middle school and high school from unfair competition.

sponsored.t: Relates to orders of protection with respect to companion animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to orders of protection with respect to companion animals; provides further protection for pets by authorizing the court to order a party to either relinquish a pet or to refrain from any contact with a pet.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing any moneys derived from new or increased taxes to reduce local real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Directs any moneys derived from new or increased taxes be used to reduce local real property taxes.
sponsored.fis: None. This bill would prohibit the creation of additional sources of state tax revenue.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the permanent or temporary housing of migrant populations in schoolhouses or on school grounds in districts outside of N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the permanent or temporary housing of migrant populations in schoolhouses or on school grounds in districts outside of a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting witnesses in criminal prosecutions from intimidation and threats
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting witnesses in criminal prosecutions from intimidation and threats by permitting the court to withhold disclosure of names and other information if the court finds on the record that such witness is subject to potential intimidation, violence or threats.

sponsored.t: Excludes volunteer firefighters and emergency medical services employees from the permissive use of marijuana
sponsored.sum: Excludes volunteer firefighters and emergency medical services employees from the permissive use of marijuana.

sponsored.t: Provides that the issue of military deployment shall not be considered as a factor in the awarding of custody in marital actions where a suitable child care plan is presented
sponsored.sum: Provides that the issue of military deployment shall not be considered as a factor in the awarding of custody in marital actions where a suitable child care plan is presented.

sponsored.t: Designates offenses against law enforcement officers, firefighters and emergency medical services personnel as hate crimes
sponsored.sum: Designates offenses against law enforcement officers, firefighters and emergency medical services personnel as hate crimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to implementing driving privilege licenses and requiring a social security number to register to vote on an application for a motor vehicle driver's license
sponsored.sum: Implements driving privilege licenses for applicants with alternative forms of identification; requires a social security number to register to vote on an application for a motor vehicle driver's license.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the board of regents to obtain legislative approval of any rule or regulation containing an unfunded mandate
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the board of regents to obtain legislative approval of any rule or regulation containing an unfunded mandate.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of assault on a pregnant individual
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of assault on a pregnant individual as a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding aggravated assault in the third degree to the penal law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the addition of aggravated assault in the third degree to the penal law.

sponsored.t: Relates to lyme disease and tick-borne infection awareness and prevention in children's summer camps
sponsored.sum: Relates to lyme disease and tick-borne infection awareness and prevention for children's overnight, summer day and traveling summer day camps; provides guidelines for treatment and notification; provides for the development of materials.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the department of health and the department of corrections and community supervision to study the effects of certain substances on law enforcement and correctional officers
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health in conjunction with the department of corrections and community supervision to identify the short-term and long-term effects of fentanyl, heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine, synthetic hallucinatory substances and certain prescription drug exposure on law enforcement officers and correctional officers who repeatedly come into contact with such substances during screening efforts at correctional facilities, raids and arrests.

sponsored.t: Enables the victim of a misdemeanor to make a statement at the sentencing of the defendant
sponsored.sum: Enables the victim of a misdemeanor to make a statement at the sentencing of the defendant.

sponsored.t: Relates to a victim's right to appeal to the state parole board
sponsored.sum: Provides that where the board has made a determination granting discretionary release to an incarcerated individual pursuant to this section, the crime victim or the victim's representative, where the crime victim is deceased or is mentally or physically incapacitated, has the right to file an appeal of such determination.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring an updated signature and photo image for renewal and display on a renewed license
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring an updated signature and photo image for renewal and display on a renewed license.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the amount of time an agency has to respond to a request under the freedom of information law
sponsored.sum: Provides that any entity subject to the provisions of article six of the public officers law which does not grant or deny a request for a record within twenty-five days of such request shall be deemed to have denied the request for such record; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding animal fighting as a criminal act when referring to enterprise corruption
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding animal fighting as a criminal act when referring to enterprise corruption.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the crime of unlawful dissemination or publication of discovery material
sponsored.sum: Creates the crime of unlawful dissemination or publication of discovery material; defines the circumstances under which a person is guilty of such crime; establishes that such crime is a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Provides for the return of persons to custody for violations of conditions of presumptive release, parole, conditional release or post-release supervision; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides for the return of persons to custody for violations of conditions of presumptive release, parole, conditional release or post-release supervision.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Any incremental increases is spending for enforcement should be greatly offset by the savings achieved from reduced criminal activity.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing notice to the crime victim or victim's representative that a parolee or releasee is being discharged or released
sponsored.sum: Requires the parole board to provide notice to the crime victim or victim's representative that a parolee or releasee is being discharged or released.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure of law enforcement personnel records; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disclosure of law enforcement personnel records; provides that law enforcement personnel records shall be considered confidential and not subject to inspection or review without the express written consent of such law enforcement officers except as mandated by lawful court order.

sponsored.t: Exempts Amityville school district from regulations regarding the use of indigenous mascots
sponsored.sum: Exempts Amityville union free school district from laws, rules, or regulations regarding the use of indigenous names, mascots, and logos.

sponsored.t: Exempts East Islip union free school district from regulations regarding the use of indigenous mascots
sponsored.sum: Exempts East Islip union free school district from laws, rules, or regulations regarding the use of indigenous names, mascots, and logos.

sponsored.t: Allows employees that refuse a coronavirus vaccine to be eligible for unemployment insurance
sponsored.sum: Allows employees that refuse a coronavirus vaccine to be eligible for unemployment insurance.

sponsored.t: Requires unanimous agreement by the parole board to release incarcerated individuals on parole
sponsored.sum: Requires unanimous agreement by the parole board to release an incarcerated individual on parole.

sponsored.t: Relates to the scheduled dredging of navigable waters
sponsored.sum: Requires that regular dredging of navigable waterways is scheduled in order to plan and finance to ensure the safe navigability and reliability of waterways in this state; requires a scheduled plan to be filed with DEC.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of taxation and finance to provide for the payment of refunds within 30 days of the receipt of a tax return
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of taxation and finance to provide for the payment by the department of taxation and finance of tax refunds within 30 days of the receipt of a taxpayer's tax return, unless there is a discrepancy in such return, in which case the department shall provide written notice to the taxpayer of such discrepancy and a date when the discrepancy will be resolved; provides failure to comply with such refund and notice requirement shall make the department of taxation and finance liable for interest on the refund due at a rate of 6% per annum.

sponsored.t: Makes any offense involving the use or possession of a firearm, shotgun or rifle bail eligible
sponsored.sum: Relates to making any offense involving the use or possession of a firearm, shotgun or rifle bail eligible.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting the sale of motor vehicles which will be modified for operation by, or for the transportation of, a person with a disability from state sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Relates to exempting the sale of motor vehicles which will be modified for operation by, or for the transportation of, a person with a disability from state sales and compensating use taxes.
sponsored.fis: Slight decrease in sales tax revenue from purchases of certain modified vehicles.

sponsored.t: Permits municipalities, schools and fire and police departments to display and sell symbols of hope
sponsored.sum: Permits municipal corporations, fire districts, volunteer fire companies, police departments and school districts to sell and display symbols of hope in support of law enforcement, emergency medical personnel, the military, border patrol, firefighters, conservation officers and others.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring telephones capable of making local and long-distance telephone calls be in every nursing home patient's room
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring telephones capable of making local and long-distance telephone calls be in every nursing home patient's room, either at such patient's bedside or in the patient's room depending on the patient's mobility.

sponsored.t: Provides that either a person or an unborn child in any stage of gestation may be the victim of an assault
sponsored.sum: Provides that either a person or an unborn child in any stage of gestation may be the victim of an assault or homicide; states situations when it does not constitute an assault on an unborn child such as during the course of an otherwise lawful abortion, during normal medical treatment or by the pregnant woman; defines "person" to include any human being who is born and is alive or an unborn child at any stage of gestation.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Stella's law" requiring CPR certified cafeteria monitors to be present in school cafeterias during lunchtimes
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Stella's law"; requires cafeteria monitors certified in first aid, CPR, and the Heimlich maneuver to be present in school cafeterias during lunchtimes.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a school district from employing certain school health professionals if such health professionals are already employed by another school district
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a school district from employing a qualified physician or nurse practitioner as a director of school health services if such qualified physician or nurse practitioner is already employed by another school district.

sponsored.t: Requires every new student at a state university of New York and a city university of New York campus receive training at orientation in the administration of opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires every new student at a state university of New York and a city university of New York campus receive training at orientation in the administration of opioid antagonists; requires each campus to provide and maintain onsite in each college-owned or college-operated building opioid antagonists.

sponsored.t: Authorizes active members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department
sponsored.sum: Authorizes active members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to purchase service credit for service with the Long Island Railroad Company police department.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Carl Spatola to receive a refund from the New York state teachers' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Carl Spatola to receive a refund from the New York state teachers' retirement system due to overpayment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the administration of COVID-19 mRNA vaccinations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the administration of COVID-19 mRNA vaccinations; requires the department of health to conduct a study and make recommendations on the benefits and risks of the administration of such vaccines; requires a self-controlled case series to be completed; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Exempts Massapequa school district from regulations regarding the use of indigenous mascots
sponsored.sum: Exempts Massapequa union free school district from laws, rules, or regulations regarding the use of indigenous names, mascots, and logos.

sponsored.t: Exempts Connetquot school district from regulations regarding the use of indigenous mascots
sponsored.sum: Exempts Connetquot central free school district from laws, rules, or regulations regarding the use of indigenous names, mascots, and logos.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities to adopt local laws requiring the use of in vessel composting
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities to adopt local laws requiring the use of in vessel composting for the disposal of organic waste that is generated from a residence.

sponsored.t: Increases criminal penalties for aggravated harassment of an elected official and criminal trespass of an elected official's residence
sponsored.sum: Increases criminal penalties for aggravated harassment of an elected official and criminal trespass of an elected official's residence; provides that aggravated harassment of an elected official shall be a class E felony and criminal trespass of an elected official's residence shall be included in criminal trespass in the first degree and shall be a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the release of certain chemical compounds into the atmosphere in this state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the intentional injection, release or dispersion, by any means, of chemicals, chemical compounds, substances or apparatus within the borders of this state into the atmosphere with the express purpose of affecting temperature, weather or the intensity of sunlight; provides the department will establish a reporting process for violations; provides penalties for such violations.
sponsored.fis: Potential increase in revenue to the air quality improvement fund from fines collected under section 71-2114.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of property taxes to municipalities by any nonprofit organization
sponsored.sum: Relates to the payment of property taxes to municipalities by any nonprofit organization; requires nonprofit organizations that would typically be exempt from property taxes based on nonprofit status to pay 75 percent of its annual property taxes to the municipality in which it sits in order to offset the impact of the exemption.

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for police officers who have a one hundred percent service-connected disability
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for police officers who have a one hundred percent service-connected disability.
sponsored.fis: Potential reduction in state income tax revenues, dependent on the number of eligible officers claiming the exemption.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance plans cover electrocardiograms for adults and children who have received a coronavirus vaccine
sponsored.sum: Requires certain health insurance plans cover electrocardiograms for adults and children who have received a coronavirus vaccine regardless of family history of heart disease or conditions.

sponsored.t: Creates the blue light emergency phones grant program
sponsored.sum: Creates the blue light emergency phones grant program for the purpose of public safety; directs a study be conducted to report upon the impact of such program.

sponsored.t: Prohibits advertisements on television and radio of cannabis and cannabis products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits advertisements on television and radio of cannabis and cannabis products subject to a $5000 fine and license or registration revocation after notice and an opportunity to be heard.

sponsored.t: Establishes privacy and publicity rights for likenesses altered using artificial intelligence
sponsored.sum: Creates penalties for likenesses altered or created by artificial intelligence being used for commercial gain; establishes a private right of action for the unlawful dissemination of still or video images generated by artificial intelligence.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale or lease of certain types of real property in the state to foreign countries of concern and foreign principals
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or lease of agricultural and forest property and real property on or within ten miles of any military installation or critical infrastructure facility in the state to foreign countries of concern and foreign principals.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York anti-mandate act"; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York anti-mandate act"; provides that a business entity doing business in the state of New York shall not refuse to provide any service, product, admission to a venue, or transportation to a person because that person has or has not received or used a medical intervention; provides that a ticket issuer shall not penalize, discriminate against, or deny access to an entertainment event to a ticket holder because the ticket holder has or has not received or used a medical intervention; provides a school operating in the state shall not mandate a medical intervention for any person to attend school, enter campus or school buildings, or be employed by the school; provides that…

sponsored.t: Requires security at all publicly accessible entrances of general hospitals
sponsored.sum: Requires security at all publicly accessible entrances of general hospitals; requires every general hospital to have either one off-duty law enforcement officer or trained security personnel be present at all times at each publicly accessible entrance or have installed locking doors at each publicly accessible entrance; requires every general hospital to provide wearable employee panic buttons or alert devices capable of immediately notifying on-site security personnel or law enforcement in the event of a dangerous situation or emergency.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the blowing of grass clippings or leaves on highways and adjacent lands
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the blowing of grass clippings or leaves on highways and adjacent lands.

sponsored.t: Requires applications for property tax exemptions by nonprofit organizations be filed at the time of purchase of a property
sponsored.sum: Requires applications for property tax exemptions by nonprofit organizations be filed at the time of purchase of a property; provides that the attorney or agent responsible for filing such application shall be fined twenty-five percent of the property's assessed taxes if such application is not timely filed.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Gerard B. Kane and Trooper Arthur B. Reddy"
sponsored.sum: Dedicates the bridge over the Southern State Parkway on Deer Park Avenue between Parkdale Drive and Sylvan Road in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to "Trooper Gerard B. Kane and Trooper Arthur B. Reddy".

sponsored.t: Designates a portion of the state highway system the "Trooper Fabio Buttitta Memorial Bridge"
sponsored.sum: Designates the bridge on Bay Shore Road in the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, the "Trooper Fabio Buttitta Memorial Bridge".

sponsored.t: Relates to designating a portion of the state highway system as the "Sergeant Gregory Wahl Memorial Highway"
sponsored.sum: Designates a portion of the state highway system as the "Sergeant Gregory Wahl Memorial Highway".

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to 9-11 Fallen Firefighters
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the Long Island Expressway in the town of Brookhaven to 9-11 Fallen Firefighters.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the Bohemia volunteer firefighter's association, and modernization of certain language
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of moneys received from foreign fire insurance companies by the Bohemia Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association, and to modernization of certain language by making such language gender neutral.

sponsored.t: Renames the "West Islip Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association" to the "West Islip Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association"
sponsored.ls: Volunteer and Exempt Firefighters' Benevolent Assoc., Inc.
sponsored.sum: Renames the "West Islip Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association" to the "West Islip Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association"; changes such association's purpose.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Charlie Bunger Sr.
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Charlie Bunger Sr. in the village of Babylon, county of Suffolk.
